claims: Ronda Rousey will return to MMA for the first time in 10 years.
Ronda Rousey will fight Gina Carano on May 16, 2026.
The fight between Ronda Rousey and Gina Carano will headline a Most Valuable Promotions event.
The event will be at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles, CA.
The fight is a 145-pound catchweight superfight.
The fight will be the first MMA event to stream live on Netflix.
Gina Carano is returning after 17 years.
The date of the fight is Saturday, May 16, 2026.
The platform for the fight is live on Netflix.
The weight class for the fight is 145 lbs featherweight.
Ronda Rousey dismissed criticism regarding her age.
Ronda Rousey confirmed her readiness to return to the cage
